meta.name: hard_mined_v2
meta.keypoints: OpenPose 21 (wrist, thumb1-4, index1-4, middle1-4, ring1-4, pinky1-4)
meta.note: hard in-the-wild hands mined by the data engine: held-out HaGRID v2 people (hg) and Open Images V7 photos (oi) on which an earlier model was off by more than 0.1 of the hand size. Labels: model candidates picked / composed / corrected on review sheets (manual = per-joint flag of a hand-placed joint). Only the mined hands are labelled (fully_annotated false: precision is not scored). A stress test, not a neutral benchmark. Test only.
